title: reverse-proxy config is a first-class versioned artefact validated by the vendor validator
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-docker-compose-host v1.0.0 blueprint with reverseProxy=caddy
iWant: a checked-in caddy/Caddyfile bind-mounted into the proxy service so the reload verb picks up an operator change, validated at gate time by caddy validate
soThat: a broken Caddyfile is caught before the reload burst runs, and there is one place in the tree the operator edits to route hostnames

acceptanceCriteria.description: The applied fixture ships caddy/Caddyfile under a caddy/ directory, the compose file bind-mounts it read-only into the caddy service, and the caddyfile-validate probe shells to caddy validate against the file (using the caddy:2 container image when a local caddy binary is not on PATH) and asserts exit 0. SIMULATE_INVALID_CADDYFILE=true writes an invalid directive and the probe FAILS naming the line. Skipped when the applied reverseProxy is not caddy.

F-5 Traefik topology: with reverseProxy=traefik, the applied fixture ships traefik/traefik.yaml bind-mounted read-only into the traefik service. The reverse-proxy validate probe reaches for the traefik binary (a `traefik healthcheck --ping` style check) or the traefik:v3 container; SIMULATE_INVALID_TRAEFIK=true injects an invalid directive and the probe FAILS naming the file and the line number.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with reverseProxy=traefik and traefik/traefik.yaml bind-mounted read-only
acceptanceCriteria.when: the validate probe runs and SIMULATE_INVALID_TRAEFIK=true trips
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shipped path validates; the mutation FAILS naming the invalid line

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-5 none topology: with reverseProxy=none, the applied fixture MUST NOT ship a caddy/ or traefik/ directory. A fixture assertion greps the applied tree and refuses if either directory is present. SIMULATE_CADDY_UNDER_NONE=true adds a caddy/Caddyfile and the assertion FAILS naming the disallowed directory.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with reverseProxy=none and SIMULATE_CADDY_UNDER_NONE=true adding caddy/
acceptanceCriteria.when: the fixture assertion walks the applied tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the assertion FAILS naming caddy/ as the disallowed directory under reverseProxy=none

acceptanceCriteria.description: Read-only bind-mount: the reverse-proxy config bind-mount in compose.yaml carries the read-only flag (":ro" suffix on the volume string, or read_only: true on the long-form). The compose-config-lint asserts the flag; SIMULATE_WRITEABLE_MOUNT=true removes it and the lint FAILS naming the service.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture with the reverse-proxy config bind-mounted read-only
acceptanceCriteria.when: the lint runs and SIMULATE_WRITEABLE_MOUNT=true trips
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shipped path passes; the mutation FAILS naming the writable mount
